description: Companion to workshop-leavebehind/valid-manifest.json. Owner-signed presidio-hardened/workshop-leavebehind@1 manifest (ikigov-assess T-B4 R1: customer anchors). The `owner` block is additive-optional within @1 (ADR-0001 D5) and lives INSIDE the signed content. Two profiles pinned: expected_content_hash is the canonical sha256 of the manifest (the value a workshop-attestation@1 `attests` would carry — the ADR-0002 DAG edge target); owner_signature is Ed25519 over the RAW canonical manifest bytes (manifest.sig profile, not the family {content_hash, signer} message). Customer test key: priv 02*32 — a cross-repo fixture, not a secret.
